posts.title: Updates on Ancestry to your Origins
posts.description: Ancestry just did its yearly update to how it categorizes your biological ancestry by adding over 150 new regions. Many areas like Ireland, Scotland, Central Europe, indigenous America, Asia, and Africa have more detailed subgroups than before and I noticed two new countries in Europe: Belgium and Switzerland. posts.title: A ceremony in Munich
posts.description: I never thought of my Jewish great grandmother Lotte (Charlotte) Thannhauser as a holocaust victim.
